title: Winter Clothes Distribution — Mirpur 10
description:
Every winter, families in the Mirpur bastis face the cold with a single thin blanket. This year we are collecting clean, gently used jackets, sweaters and shawls and handing them out directly to 400 households around Mirpur 10 and Kazipara.

Volunteers will help sort donations from 9:00 AM, pack family bundles and walk the distribution route with our local ward volunteers. Bring a reusable bag if you can, and wear comfortable shoes. Tea and lunch are on us.

title: Buriganga Riverbank Cleanup
description:
The Buriganga is the lifeline of old Dhaka, and it needs a hand. Join a 300-strong volunteer team to clear plastic, cloth waste and construction debris from a two-kilometre stretch of the riverbank near Sadarghat.

Gloves, sacks, grabbers and drinking water will be provided at the volunteer desk from 7:00 AM. We finish before the afternoon heat, and every full sack you collect earns your team a point on the live cleanup scoreboard.

title: Tree Plantation Drive at Chandrima Udyan
description:
We are planting 500 native saplings — krishnachura, jarul, neem and bot — along the walking paths of Chandrima Udyan with Dhaka North City Corporation's horticulture team.

Each volunteer gets five saplings, a planting kit and a named tag that stays with the tree. Our team returns every month to water and check survival, so this is a year-long promise, not a one-day photo.

title: Free Health Camp for Senior Citizens
description:
A free day of check-ups for anyone over 60: blood pressure, blood sugar, eye screening, dental advice and a consultation with a licensed physician. Medicines prescribed on the day are dispensed free of charge.

We need volunteers to welcome guests, manage the queue, help with registration and serve a light lunch. Bengali and a little patience are the only qualifications. Doctors and nurses from Uttara Crescent Hospital are donating their time.

title: Winter Blanket Drive — Kurigram
description:
Kurigram gets colder than most of Bangladesh, and the char villages along the Brahmaputra feel it first. We are raising 1,500 heavy blankets and delivering them house to house in Char Rajibpur and Chilmari.

Volunteers will help load the truck, cross by boat with our local partners and record every household we reach. It is a long day and a muddy one, but you will not forget the faces at the door.

title: Blood Donation Camp at Chittagong Medical College
description:
Thalassaemia patients at Chattogram Medical College Hospital need 40 units of blood every week. Our camp, run with the hospital's transfusion department, aims to collect 100 units in a single day.

Donors must be 18 or older, weigh at least 50 kg and have eaten within the last four hours. Volunteers are needed to register donors, serve juice and biscuits, and walk first-time donors through the process calmly.

title: School Supplies for Hill Tract Students
description:
Three primary schools in Bandarban Sadar are short of basic learning material. We are packing 600 kits with exercise books, pencils, colour pencils, a geometry box and a reusable water bottle for students in classes one to five.

Volunteers will assemble kits at the community hall and join the distribution walk to two of the schools. If you can carry a backpack for a few kilometres, you can make a child's whole school year.

title: Community Iftar & Food Pack Distribution
description:
An open iftar for 500 people in Zindabazar, followed by the distribution of 300 dry food packs for families in the surrounding neighbourhoods. The menu is simple and filling: khichuri, roast, borhani, dates and water.

We need hands to set up the long tables, serve, and clean up afterwards, plus a small team to deliver packs to households where an elderly person lives alone. Everyone is welcome at the table, whatever your faith or background.

title: Sea Beach Cleanup — Cox's Bazar
description:
Laboni Point collected more than two tonnes of plastic last winter. This season we are going again, with gloves, weighing scales and a recycling partner who will take every sack we fill.

We start at sunrise to beat the heat and finish by 11:00 AM. Families are welcome; children under 12 must stay with a guardian. Bring a hat, a refillable bottle and a friend.

title: Flood Relief Volunteer Training
description:
When the Brahmaputra rises, the first 48 hours decide everything. This one-day training covers boat safety, safe drinking water handling, shelter registration and how to support families without creating dependency.

Led by experienced volunteers from the 2024 Kurigram response, with a practical drill in the afternoon. Attendance is free and participants receive a certificate. Priority goes to people who can commit to at least two days during the monsoon season.

title: Monsoon Plantation at Padma Riverbank
description:
We planted 300 palm and hijal saplings along the Padma embankment in Rajshahi with students from Rajshahi University. The monsoon rains gave every sapling a strong start, and our follow-up visit found a 92 percent survival rate.

Thank you to the 118 volunteers who spent a wet Saturday morning digging, mulching and tagging. This event has ended, but the trees are still growing.

title: Winter Blanket Drive 2025 — Khulna
description:
Our first winter drive in Khulna reached 320 families in Sonadanga and Khalishpur with thick blankets, warm socks and a hot meal on distribution day.

The event is closed and the final impact report is published. Every taka donated was spent on blankets and transport; volunteer time was unpaid. Thank you to everyone who made it possible.
